query: List ALL 32 first-level administrative divisions of Mexico (Tamaulipas; Jalisco; Tlaxcala; Aguascalientes; México; Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave; Michoacán de Ocampo; Baja California; Yucatán; Morelos; Baja California Sur; Zacatecas; Nayarit; Campeche; Nuevo León; Chihuahua; Oaxaca; Chiapas; Puebla; Ciudad de México; Querétaro; Coahuila de Zaragoza; Quintana Roo; Colima; Sinaloa; Durango; San Luis Potosí; Guerrero; Sonora; Guanajuato; Tabasco; Hidalgo). For each give: the executive office title in English and the local language, how that office is filled, its term length, the CURRENT officeholder as of 2026-11-14 (full name, party name and acronym, coalition, term start and end, whether acting/interim) with source URLs, and the division's legislature (English and local name, number of seats, how filled). Explain in special_status_note any division whose governance differs from the others (for example a capital district).
